about_the_game:
Support Warspace 2 and command a fleet built for true explorers!

The Supporter Pack is a special thank-you to players who want to help the continued development of Warspace 2. This DLC unlocks access to three exclusive ships: one available right away, and two more that can be purchased as you level up in the game.

You'll start with a special Tier I ship immediately. As you advance your pilot level, you'll unlock the ability to purchase the Tier II and Tier III supporter ships — each one more prestigious than the last.

By purchasing this pack, you’re helping us bring even more content, updates, and adventures to Warspace 2. Thank you for being part of the journey!

Key Features:

  • Exclusive Supporter Tier I Ship — Available immediately at game start

  • Supporter Tier II and Tier III Ships — Unlockable through normal gameplay progression (level requirement applies)

  • Support future updates and the growth of Warspace 2
